description: This Java class 'ReadingGoalCalculator' provides utility methods for calculating and assessing a user's reading progress towards their yearly reading goals. It includes methods to determine how many books should have been read by now, how many were read this year, progress towards the goal, and schedule status (ahead or behind), based on the current week of the year and data from associated classes such as Book and PredefinedShelf.

classes.name: ReadingGoalCalculator
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating reading progress, schedule adherence, and related metrics based on books and dates.

methods.name: shouldHaveRead
methods.description: Calculates the number of books that should have been read by this point in the year to stay on target based on the total goal.

methods.name: booksToReadFromStartOfYear
methods.description: Calculates the weekly average of books to read from the start of the year based on the total goal.

methods.name: howManyReadThisYear
methods.description: Counts how many books or pages have been read this year, depending on the GoalType, considering only books with finish dates in the current year.

methods.name: bookHasFinishDateInThisYear
methods.description: Determines if a given book was finished within the current year.

methods.name: howFarAheadOrBehindSchedule
methods.description: Computes how many books ahead or behind schedule the user is based on their total goal and progress.

methods.name: calculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of the reading goal completed based on books read versus target.

methods.name: behindOrAheadSchedule
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the user is ahead or behind schedule based on books read and schedule estimate.
